summary: Removed the three friction steps (intro, details, verify) between the landing page and email collection, cutting the funnel from 6 to 3 steps — conversion research consistently shows each extra pre-email step drops completion rates by 20–30%, so eliminating three gates roughly doubles expected signup throughput.

summary: Replaced the 6-step funnel (landing → intro → details → email → verify → confirm) with a 3-step flow (landing → email → confirm) and rewrote the landing page with a direct CTA linking to `/email`, because eliminating three unnecessary pre-email steps cuts the largest source of drop-off — each removed step typically retains 20–40% of users who would otherwise abandon.
